outcome: Prevalence of feeding complements in newborns
cohort: 415 mothers and their full-term, appropriate-weight-for-gestational-age newborns with Apgar scores ≥ 7 at 1 and 5 minutes from four public maternity hospitals in Natal, Brazil
finding: Maternal age ≤ 20 years and 20-30 years were protective factors against complement feeding, while being primiparous and having a cesarean section were risk factors.
mod_finding: Cesarean section was identified as a risk factor for complement feeding in newborns.
